lines.beaver: 나 요즘 결혼 준비 때문에 정신이 하나도 없어.
lines.beaver_en: I'm so swamped with wedding prep these days.
lines.beaver_roman: na yojeum gyeolhon junbi ttaemune jeongsini hanado eopseo.
lines.en: Did the families meet yet? What do both sides say?

lines.beaver: 지난주에 했어. 근데 예물 얘기가 나와서 걱정이야.
lines.beaver_en: Last week. But engagement gifts came up, so I'm worried.
lines.beaver_roman: jinanjue haesseo. geunde yemul yaegiga nawaseo geokjeongiya.
lines.learner: 예물은 필수가 아니야. 반지 하나면 충분하지.
lines.en: Gifts aren't a must. One ring is enough.
lines.roman: yemureun pilsuga aniya. banji hanamyeon chungbunhaji.

lines.beaver: 그래도 결혼인데 너무 소박하면 서운하지 않을까?
lines.beaver_en: But it's a wedding. Won't it feel sad if it's too plain?
lines.beaver_roman: geuraedo gyeolhoninde neomu sobakamyeon seounhaji aneulkka?
lines.learner: 둘이 행복하면 그만이야. 남의 눈은 신경 쓰지 마.
lines.en: As long as you two are happy, that's all. Ignore others.
lines.roman: duri haengbokamyeon geumaniya. namui nuneun singyeong sseuji ma.

lines.beaver: 주례는 모셔야 할까? 아는 분이 별로 없어.
lines.beaver_en: Should we have an officiant? We don't know many people.
lines.beaver_roman: juryeneun moseoya halkka? aneun buni byeollo eopseo.
lines.learner: 요즘은 주례 없이 하는 경우가 많아.
lines.en: Lots of people skip the officiant these days.
lines.roman: yojeumeun jurye eopsi haneun gyeonguga mana.

lines.beaver: 그렇구나. 너는 어떻게 그렇게 잘 알아?
lines.beaver_en: I see. How do you know so much?
lines.beaver_roman: geureokuna. neoneun eotteoke geureoke jal ara?
lines.learner: 내 친구가 작년에 결혼했는데 아주 간소하게 했어.
lines.en: My friend married last year and kept it very simple.
lines.roman: nae chinguga jangnyeone gyeolhonhaenneunde aju gansohage haesseo.

lines.beaver_en: Did she date her husband for a long time?
lines.en: Yes, five years, then married. A match made in heaven.

lines.beaver: 부럽다. 나는 한때 독신으로 살 줄 알았는데.
lines.beaver_en: I'm jealous. I once thought I'd stay single.
lines.beaver_roman: bureopda. naneun hanttae doksineuro sal jul aranneunde.
lines.learner: 맞아, 너 결혼 안 할 거라고 했었잖아.
lines.en: Right, you used to say you'd never marry.
lines.roman: maja, neo gyeolhon an hal georago haesseotjana.

lines.beaver: 하하, 그랬지. 그럼 돈은 어디에 쓰면 좋을까?
lines.beaver_en: Haha, I did. So where should we spend the money?
lines.beaver_roman: haha, geuraetji. geureom doneun eodie sseumyeon joeulkka?
lines.learner: 신혼집에 쓰는 게 더 현실적이고 합리적이야.
lines.en: Spending it on your new home is more realistic and sensible.
lines.roman: sinhonjibe sseuneun ge deo hyeonsiljeogigo hamnijeogiya.

lines.beaver: 맞아. 예비 신랑한테도 그렇게 말해 볼게.
lines.beaver_en: True. I'll tell my fiancé that too.
lines.beaver_roman: maja. yebi sillanghantedo geureoke malhae bolge.
lines.en: Good thinking. As long as your hearts connect, that's all.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. Talking about it made me feel better.
lines.learner: 만나면 꼭 안아 줄게. 결혼 축하해!
lines.en: I'll give you a big hug when we meet. Congrats!
lines.roman: mannamyeon kkok ana julge. gyeolhon chukahae!
